Credits.Title: Reset credits
History.Title: Recent reset history
Settings.ResetAllConfirm: Reset all settings to their defaults?
Settings.LanguageHint: Auto follows the Windows display language.
Settings.NotificationHint: Notifications are shown only when needed.
Settings.CodexPathHint: Leave blank to detect Codex automatically.
Usage.EnableInSettings: Enable read-only usage collection in Settings.
Usage.NoData: No usage metadata is available for this period.
Settings.RetentionInternalCleanup: Expired rows are cleaned at startup and no more than once every 24 hours. There is no separate automatic-cleanup switch.
Settings.ConfirmationDelay: A recovery is checked again after 20 seconds before it is recorded.
Settings.UsagePrivacyReadOnly: Read-only: only known Codex session folders are scanned. Message content, commands, diffs, repository paths, IDs and account data are never stored.
Settings.EstimateUnavailable: Unavailable until a verified rate table is installed. This switch cannot be enabled and no currency is assumed.
Settings.BackupHint: Exports and imports settings only. Local session content is never included.
Settings.AdvancedHint: Logs are redacted and retained separately from reset history and usage aggregates.
Settings.ShowCachedOnFailure: Show the last cached value after an update failure
Settings.ConnectionStatusHint: Status has not been checked in this dialog.
Settings.ResetReadOnlyHint: Quota access is read-only. Recoveries are confirmed after the fixed 20-second delay before recording.
Settings.UsageKnownRoots: Targets: CODEX_HOME/sessions and, when enabled, CODEX_HOME/archived_sessions only.
Settings.UsageNotScanned: No scan has run in this dialog.
Settings.ClearCacheConfirm: Rebuild local scan cache on the next scan?
Help.Refresh: Refresh the displayed quota and connection information now.
Help.ShowMini: Switch to the smallest weekly-quota view.
Help.ShowCompact: Switch to the compact quota, reset-credit, and history view.
Help.Close: Hide this window. QuantaTray continues running in the system tray.
Help.OverviewTab: Show weekly quota, reset credits, connection status, and recent reset history.
Help.UsageTab: Show local model, token, elapsed-time, turn, and reasoning aggregates.
Help.UsagePeriod: Select the local session period included in the usage aggregation.
Help.UsageMetric: Select the value used to compare and sort models.
Help.Rescan: Read newly added Codex session metadata now. A running scan is not duplicated.
Help.Model: Model identifier recorded in local Codex session metadata.
Help.Share: Share of the selected metric within the displayed period.
Help.TotalTokens: Total tokens reported in local session usage metadata.
Help.ElapsedTime: Elapsed activity time inferred from local session timestamps.
Help.TurnCount: Number of locally recorded turns in the displayed period.
Help.Reasoning: Breakdown of recorded reasoning-effort levels for this model.
Help.FastRate: Share recorded with the fast or priority service tier.
Help.Language: Auto uses Japanese only when the Windows display language is Japanese; otherwise it uses English.
Help.Opacity: Adjust the opacity of mini, compact, and detailed views. Settings remains opaque.
Help.AlwaysOnTop: Keep QuantaTray panels above other windows.
Help.RememberPosition: Restore the last monitor and panel position at startup.
Help.SnapToEdge: Snap a moved panel to the nearest screen edge.
Help.MiniClickThrough: Let mouse clicks pass through the mini view. Compact and detailed views remain interactive.
Help.DisplayMode: Preview the selected mini, compact, or detailed view without closing Settings.
Help.UsageEnabled: Enable read-only collection of local Codex session usage metadata.
Help.UsageInterval: Choose how often newly added local session metadata is scanned.
Help.UsageOnOpen: Run an immediate incremental scan when the Usage Analysis tab opens.
Help.IncludeArchives: Also scan the known CODEX_HOME archived_sessions folder.
Help.RebuildCache: Discard the local scan index and rebuild aggregates on the next scan. Session files are not changed.
Help.UsagePeriodDefault: Choose the period initially selected when Usage Analysis opens.
Help.UsageMetricDefault: Choose the comparison metric initially selected when Usage Analysis opens.
Help.GroupOther: Combine models beyond the individual display limit into Other.
